body.x: JASHEN, a leading innovator in household chores, announced the launch of three new smart vacuum models at the first fully online CES 2021 on January 11. These models include the F16 wireless dust and water vacuum cleaner with removable lithium-ion battery and patented BRN technology to prevent hair tangle the M16 multi-stage cleaner with complete detection system of contaminated water; and the S10 robot vacuum cleaner and mop compatible with Alexa and Google Echo
Dust and water vacuum cleaner 2-en1 F16
Scheduled for the first half of 2021, the F16 model incorporates 10 patented technologies for its innovation and usefulness. The useful then combines with the performance.

The F16 is a powerful wireless vacuum cleaner with a removable battery that offers a maximum running time of 60 minutes and covers an area of 120 m2, allowing for a completely clean floor in a single pass.

BRN's innovative and patented technology allows the F16 to clean seamlessly and not get in the way of the hair. Its improved structure allows it to quickly suck up large particles of waste for quick and easy cleaning.

The M16 is equipped with "Dirty Tank Full" technology, which automatically monitors the volume of contaminated water and warns when the bin needs to be emptied to prevent sewage overflowing. One-click water cleaning technology makes it easy to activate the self-cleaning function with a single click.
The S10 vacuum robot is compatible with Alexa and Google Echo

The S10 vacuum robot has automatic mop and suction function, gyroscopic navigation and automatic surface detection. The S10's ultra-thin design allows it to fully cover and reach areas under beds, sofas and where dirt hides
